theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Consumer Discretionary (+1.31%) and Materials (+0.89%) led the market today, while Health Care (-0.29%) and Consumer Staples (-0.24%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.85%, defensives -0.07%, and value/cyclicals +0.44% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.72%, Dow +0.44%, Nasdaq +1.22% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +1.05%, outperforming large caps. The VIX fell 4.33% to 15.67, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 0.91% to $4,167.40, crude oil was little changed at $91.45, and bitcoin gained 0.02% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
